rules.text: Before merging anything that reads/writes a file, spawns a process, or builds a path: strip a UTF-8 BOM before parsing, quote paths for the host shell, resolve the interpreter from process.execPath or sys.executable, and normalize CRLF.

A version bump touches all 10 manifests, then run node scripts/check-versions.js. Pin an absolute version and compare it to the release tag; never rely on pairwise agreement between manifests, because they can all be stale together.
Editing AGENTS.md or a skill body requires re-syncing the adapter mirrors in the same PR; run node scripts/check-rule-copies.js.
In this PR-driven repository a fix does not follow the commit it repairs. Use the topic probe, not the timing probe, to find recurrence.
Recurrence here is topical: portability, manifests, uninstall, statusline, config. Run both unigram clustering and an explicit keyword probe.
A revert of a skill-body rule change must also re-sync the adapter mirrors.
Any change to what install writes must be matched in scripts/uninstall.js and tests/uninstall.test.js in the same PR. Install/uninstall symmetry is a contract, not two scripts.
A fix ships with the test that would have caught it; platform fixes go in tests/hooks-windows.test.js.

checklist.text: Run npm install && npm test; all 15 test files plus both guard scripts must pass.
Read AGENTS.md and docs/agent-portability.md; they are the authoritative adapter rules.
Confirm a clean tree with git status --porcelain.
Reading/writing a file, spawning a process, or building a path: apply all four portability guards (BOM, shell quoting, interpreter resolution, CRLF).
Bumping a version: update all 10 manifests, then run node scripts/check-versions.js.
Adding a platform adapter: add its manifest to check-versions.js and to check-rule-copies.js in the same PR.
Editing AGENTS.md or a skill body: run node scripts/check-rule-copies.js and re-sync the mirrors.
Touching install behaviour: change scripts/uninstall.js and tests/uninstall.test.js in the same PR.
Every fix ships with the test that would have caught it; platform fixes go in tests/hooks-windows.test.js.
Run all three CI commands locally: node scripts/check-rule-copies.js, node scripts/check-versions.js, npm test.
Do not merge a change that only edits one adapter's copy of a rule.
Do not add a hardcoded interpreter name (python3, bash) or an unquoted absolute path.
